name: hundred-stories-trailer
description: Standalone Remotion marketing trailer for Hundred Stories. Not part of the game bundle.

scripts.render:splash-portrait: remotion render src/index.ts SiteSplashPortrait out/site-splash-portrait.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/site-splash-portrait.mp4 -vf scale=720:1280:flags=lanczos:out_range=tv -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 26 -pix_fmt yuv420p -an -movflags +faststart ../public/trailers/site-splash-portrait.mp4 && remotion still src/index.ts SiteSplashPortrait out/site-splash-portrait.png --frame=200 --image-format=png && cwebp -quiet -q 70 -m 6 out/site-splash-portrait.png -o ../public/trailers/site-splash-portrait.webp
